title: dwg-rs status, denominator, container-boundary evidence, and codec-lineage refresh
mode: Broader primary-source OSS implementation review and plan refinement
scope: Refresh the previously identified dwg-rs candidate and nearby wrapper routes against current public source pages.
Assess dwg-rs as a possible bounded DWG container/object-walk cross-check, separating its implementation independence from shared spec authority and disclosed algorithm-comment lineage.
Deduplicate LibreDWG-backed wrappers and separate DWG, DXF, writer, visualization, and 3D semantic evidence.
Refine only existing comparator admission, frame-boundary, and evidence-denominator gates; preserve fixture and reduced-validation constraints.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source GitHub repository, README, status, clean-room, and threat-model review
method.evidenceRule: A distinct parser implementation can be a useful cross-check, but a shared ODA specification is not an independent normative authority. Capability tables and aggregate decode percentages do not establish per-version, per-record semantic fidelity or writer acceptance.

evidence.observed: The project declares an Apache-2.0 Rust DWG reader authored from ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1. Its README marks it pre-alpha, source-only/unpublished 0.1.0-alpha.1, with a shipping container/object-walker layer and incomplete entity decoders. It reports a dated 19-file corpus with 3,911 decoded, 525 skipped, 9 errored, and 88.0% aggregate coverage, but only one AC1032 sample. It documents no DXF reader, alpha writer paths, no automated external CAD acceptance, incomplete owner/block graph traversal, and approximate glTF tessellation. The threat model lists bounded parsing but says extended fuzz runs are not yet logged. The project claims it did not consult/import LibreDWG source, while disclosing ACadSharp algorithm-comment consultation for an LZ77 offset ambiguity.
evidence.limits: Mutable main was not bound to an immutable commit or built artifact and was not executed. The same README later repeats older 90.3% aggregate / 85.9% AC1032 and 649-test figures, while the dated STATUS states 88.0% and 774 tests; this is documentation freshness conflict. The clean-room account is a project declaration, not an independent legal/source audit. Shared ODA v5.4.1 means it cannot independently settle normative byte-layout questions; its disclosed ACadSharp comment lineage further limits an independent LZ77 vote.
evidence.planUse: Classify as OPTIONAL_CONTAINER_CANDIDATE / NOT_RUN. If a uniquely useful local ambiguity remains, pin commit, source archive/build hash, Cargo.lock, toolchain, command, input hashes, and exact denominator. Use it for section/object-frame diagnostics only; do not admit aggregate scores, writer, 3D, or ACIS semantics.

evidence.observed: The project describes DWG parsing through LibreDWG FFI and DXF parsing through the separate pure-Rust undxf crate, with JSON/SVG/PNG output and no current DWG/DXF writer API.
evidence.limits: No exact release/source pin or execution was made. DWG results share LibreDWG parser lineage; DXF syntax/projection cannot establish DWG parity or writer fidelity.
evidence.planUse: Do not count as a new DWG codec. Consider only as a separately pinned DXF observer if a remaining exact DXF question warrants it.

evidence.observed: Public project descriptions identify LibreDWG as the default DWG parsing/conversion backend beneath web and rendering layers.
evidence.limits: Wrapper, UI, and renderer behavior are not independent codec implementations and were not run.
evidence.planUse: Deduplicate with LibreDWG for parser-lineage counts; treat rendering as a separate consumer operation.

evidence.observed: Added a source-backed candidate classification and a bounded optional run recipe under existing PAR-07/S8 and PAR-14 owners; recorded test-denominator and codec-lineage limits.
evidence.limits: No local parser correctness result follows from peer documentation. Existing historical plan count entries vary between 141 and 142 and were not recalculated in this pass.
evidence.planUse: Use an exact-pinned optional route only if it answers a specific unresolved question; otherwise record NOT_RUN and continue local work.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-07/S8: classify dwg-rs as an optional, not-yet-admitted container/object-boundary candidate; pin immutable source and run only at a composed checkpoint when it answers a local question.
PAR-07/S8: deduplicate uncad and mlightcad wrappers by their underlying DWG codec lineage; separate DXF parser, consumer, and rendering roles.
PAR-14: compare exact section/object boundaries and per-record decoded/skipped/errored dispositions; avoid aggregate percentages and source-doc/test-count drift.
